name: Shorikai, Genesis Engine
oracle_text:
{1}, {T}: Draw two cards, then discard a card. Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
Crew 8 (Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 8 or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.)
blocked_sentences: {1}, {T}: Draw two cards, then discard a card. Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."

needs.what: a token definition for the Pilot this card makes, so `create_token` may name it. Printed exactly: "a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with \"This token crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater.\"" -- suggested id `pilot_1_1_c_crew2`, name "Pilot Token", types ["Creature"], subtypes ["Pilot"], colors [], color_identity [], power 1, toughness 1, is_token true, added to data/cards/tokens.cards.json. The token is NOT a plain vanilla 1/1: it carries one printed quoted ability, verbatim -- "This token crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." -- and defining the token exactly means giving that line a home too. It is a static ability of the token that raises, by 2, the power this creature contributes while paying a `crew` cost, and only while paying one: it is not a `buff`, because the token stays a 1/1 for combat, for `power_of`, and for every other sum on the board. Nothing in `static_effects` says it (the list has `buff`, `set_pt` and `grant_keyword`, all of which change actual power), and the summing lives inside the cost rather than in characteristics -- `_tap_cost_pool` totals derived power to decide whether a `tap_permanents` with `total_power` is payable -- so the capability wanted is a per-creature crew-power bonus that only that sum consults. Crew itself is not the gap: `tap_permanents` with `total_power` ships and is documented as crew (docs/card-dsl.md "Crew -- a tap cost measured in power", docs/keywords.md marks Crew shipped), so Shorikai's own "Crew 8" line needs nothing new.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `create_token` carries only `token`, `amount`, `as`, `attacking`, `controller` and `tapped` -- `token` is an id string naming a card already in the pool, with no inline token body and no size, colour, subtype, keyword or ability override on the op; `reference.token_ids` is a closed list and `loader.validate_token_references` rejects an unknown id at load time, so the card cannot ship ahead of the definition. The pool has no Pilot token of any size, and no colourless 1/1 with an ability of this shape. The nearest bodies are `gnome_1_1_c` (1/1 colourless, but a Gnome, an artifact creature, and with no ability) and `hero_1_1_c` (1/1 colourless Hero, vanilla); substituting either would give the wrong creature type -- a real cost on a card whose whole point is manufacturing crew -- and would silently drop the +2 crew rider, which is the only reason this token is worth more than a Servo.
needs.blocks_only: the token clause of the activated ability; every other line of the card, including Crew 8, is expressible today

notes: The Pilot token is the ONLY blocker.
